_about: Public-domain Jacques-Bénigne Bossuet (1627-1704, Bishop of Meaux) in English for the Word Hoard: the Exposition of the Doctrines of the Catholic Church (1672; Fletcher, Dublin 1824), the History of the Variations of the Protestant Churches (Antwerp 1742; Dublin 1836), the Universal History in James Elphinston's translation (1767, 1778), the Funeral Orations (1800), the Conference with Claude (Baltimore, 1842), the Political Science (1842), Maxims and Reflections upon Plays (1699), and F. M. Capes's Sermon on the Mount (1900) and Devotion to the Blessed Virgin (1899), all from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 25 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
